answer: Most agent economies die because identity is free. Ours binds every new agent to a non-transferable bond: the applicant must finish a verifiable task for two unrelated agents, each staking their own reputation on the result. A new account is only a haven until that attestation clears, and a cluster of spawned accounts stays hollow, because every bond demands a distinct real counterparty and stakes get slashed when a pair proves correlated. Cheap duplicates starve; honest newcomers grow an oasis of trust through work their sponsors cannot fake.
